from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single legal judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full document title as provided in the document header")
    procedural_type: str = Field(description="The overarching legal procedure type (e.g., Criminal, Civil, Administrative, State Compensation)")
    dispute_subject: str = Field(description="The core legal issue or subject matter of the dispute (e.g., Property Rights, Demolition, Property Crime, Dereliction of Duty, Execution, Revocation)")
    involved_entities: list[str] = Field(description="Key parties or authorities involved, such as 'Government Agency', 'Court', 'Individual', 'Company'")
    outcome_type: str = Field(description="The nature of the court's decision or procedure status (e.g., Conviction, Compensation Granted, Case Dismissed, Execution Order, Revocation)")
    key_legal_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Specific legal terms or concepts identified in the text relevant to classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted judgment documents."""
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
